title: Elementary Chemical Engineering Lab
description: Introduction to engineering accounting, basic statistics, dynamic systems, Excel spreadsheets, problem solving, and engineering graphics.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in ENGR 102 and MATH 151 or approval of department.

title: Elementary Chemical Engineering
description: Solution of elementary problems by application of mass balances, energy balances and equilibrium relationships.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Grade of C or better in CHEM 120 , ENGR 102 , and MATH 152 ; grade of C or better in CHEN 201 or concurrent enrollment; grade of C or better in PHYS 206 , and PHYS 216/ENGR 216 or ENGR 216/PHYS 216 ; admission to chemical engineering major or approval of department.

title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics I
description: First and second laws of thermodynamics; volumetric properties of pure fluids; heat effects; applications to flow processes, power cycles, refrigeration.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 201 and CHEN 204 .

title: Directed Studies
description: Directed study of special projects or studies in chemical engineering processes or operations, for lower division students. Credit not applicable to degree requirements in chemical engineering.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Freshman or sophomore classification; approval of department head.

title: Special Topics in...
description: Selected topics in an identified area of chemical engineering for lower division students. May be repeated for credit. Credit not applicable to degree requirements in chemical engineering.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Approval of instructor.

title: Research
description: Research conducted under the direction of faculty member in chemical engineering. May be repeated two times for credit.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Approval of instructor.
repeatability: May be repeated two times for credit.

title: Chemical Engineering Fluid Operations
description: Fundamentals of fluid mechanics with applications to design and analysis of process equipment.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: CHEN 204 with a grade of C or better; CHEN 205 or concurrent enrollment; MATH 308 with a grade of C or better.

title: Numerical Analysis for Chemical Engineers
description: Applications of numerical analysis techniques to mathematical models of processes common to chemical and associated industries; computational methods and software for analysis of chemical engineering processes.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: CHEN 205 with a grade of C or better; MATH 308 with a grade of C or better; or approval of department.

title: Chemical Engineering Materials
description: Overview of materials science with particular emphasis on classes of materials relevant to chemical engineers.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Grade of C or better in CHEN 204 , MATH 251 or concurrent enrollment, and CHEN 205 or concurrent enrollment; or approval of department.

title: Chemical Engineering Heat Transfer Operations
description: Heat transfer operations.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Grade of C or better in CHEN 205 and CHEN 304 .

title: Chemical Engineering Mass Transfer Operations
description: Mass transfer operations with applications to design and analysis of process equipment.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 354 ; grade of C or better in CHEN 323 or concurrent enrollment; or approval of department.

title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics II
description: Applications of thermodynamics to pure and mixed fluids; phase equilibria and chemical reaction equilibria.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: CHEN 205 and MATH 308 with a grade of C or better; or approval of department.

title: Kinetics and Reactor Design
description: Kinetics of reactions and application of fundamental principles to design and operation of commercial reactors.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 320 ; grade of C or better in CHEN 323 and CHEN 324 , or concurrent enrollment, or approval of department.

title: Chemical Engineering Process Industries
description: Overview of the major chemical process and related industries including key sectors, history, operating principles, supply chains; focus on technical, market, sustainability, and safety aspects.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 304 and CHEN 354 .

title: Mid-Curriculum Professional Development
description: Participation in an approved high-impact learning practice; reflection on professional outcomes from engineering body of knowledge; documentation and self-assessment of learning experience at mid-curriculum point.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: CHEN 204 and ENGL 210 ; junior or senior classification or approval of instructor.

title: Humanitarian Engineering
description: Basic concepts of humanitarian engineering; application of engineering and technology for the benefit of humanity and especially disadvantaged communities; understanding the role of engineers in achieving sustainable development goals; identification, formulation and solution of related engineering and design problems considering historical, cultural, ethical and practical perspectives.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Junior or senior classification in the College of Engineering; approval of instructor.

title: Unit Operations in Food Processing
description: Design of food process engineering systems; basic concepts of rheology and physical properties of foods; fundamentals of heat and mass transfer and process control.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 205 and CHEN 304 , or MEEN 221 . Cross Listing: BAEN 422/CHEN 422 .

title: Process Integration, Simulation and Economics
description: Integration, simulation, and economic methods involved in the design of chemical processes and equipment.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 320 , CHEN 323 , CHEN 354 , and CHEN 324 or concurrent enrollment.

title: Chemical Engineering Plant Design
description: Integration of material from other chemical engineering courses with applications to the design of plants and processes representative of the chemical and related process industries.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 322 , CHEN 364 , CHEN 374 and CHEN 425 .

title: Risk Engineering
description: Concepts of risk and risk assessment, including use of all available information to provide a foundation for risk-informed and cost-effective engineering practices; examples and exercises from a variety of engineering areas.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Junior or senior classification. Cross Listing: SENG 430/CHEN 430 .

title: Chemical Engineering Laboratory I
description: Laboratory work based on CHEN 304 and CHEN 323 .
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 323 and ENGL 210 .

title: Chemical Engineering Laboratory II
description: Laboratory work based on CHEN 324 , CHEN 364 , CHEN 432 , and CHEN 461 .
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 324 , CHEN 364 , CHEN 432 , and CHEN 461 .

title: Nanomaterials for Energy Conversion
description: Instruction in ultra-small materials useful for fabricating next-generation energy conversion devices (e.g., thermoelectrics, and photovoltaics) synthesized in various forms including nanoparticles and quantum dots, nanowires and nanotubes, and thin films; exploration of the fabrication and assembly of these materials; involves the use of both traditional materials syntheses approaches (e.g., chemical vapor deposition) and newer syntheses approaches (e.g., template-assisted syntheses of nanomaterials); materials syntheses, characterization and assembly of these nanomaterials; exploration of the basics of crystal structures, necessary for understanding structure-property relationships in materials.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Junior or senior classification.

title: Microfabrication and Microfluidics Technology
description: Micro Electro Mechanical Systems (MEMS) technology; study the fundamentals of fluidics, heat and mass transfer, surface chemistry, and electrochemical interactions.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Junior or senior classification.

title: Introduction to Polymer Engineering
description: Fundamentals of polymer reaction kinetics, morphology, chemical and rheological properties with applications to polymer synthesis, production and processing operations.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Senior classification in chemical engineering or approval of instructor.

title: Process Safety Engineering
description: Applications of engineering principles to process safety and hazards analysis, mitigation, and prevention, with special emphasis on the chemical process industries; includes source modeling for leakage rates, dispersion, analysis, relief valve sizing, fire and explosion damage analysis, hazards identification, risk analysis, accident investigations.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 322 ; senior classification; engineering majors. Cross Listing: SENG 455/CHEN 455 .

title: Advanced Chemical Process Optimization I
description: State-of-the-art optimization based techniques for process synthesis, process design and process operability; emphasis on mathematical modeling via mixed integer and continuous optimization formulations and application to heat integration problems; use modeling/optimization software systems.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Senior classification or approval of instructor.

title: Environmental Engineering
description: Overview of environmental engineering for chemical engineers; analyzing and solving environmental problems associated with engineered systems; emphasis on water/wastewater quality and treatment, air pollution control, and soil and hazardous waste management; includes guest lectures and field trips.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: CHEN 304 and CHEN 354 or approval of instructor; junior or senior classification; Qatar campus.

title: Gas and Petroleum Processing
description: Design and operation of petroleum and gas processing facilities including hydrate suppression, dehydration, sweetening, sulfur recovery, LPG and liquid recovery, refining operations; analysis of the design and operations involving a large degree of process simulation.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 323 .

title: Quantitative Risk Analysis in Safety Engineering
description: Fundamental concepts, techniques, and applications of risk analysis and risk-informed decision making for engineering students; practical uses of probabilistic methods are demonstrated in exercises and case studies from diverse engineering areas.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Senior or graduate classification. Cross Listing: SENG 460/CHEN 460 .

title: Process Dynamics and Control
description: Analysis of process dynamics and methods for the design of automatic control systems for chemical process plants.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Grade of C or better in CHEN 320 and CHEN 364 or concurrent enrollment.

title: Systems Biology
description: Experimental and computational techniques in systems biology; includes high throughput experiments, data analysis, modeling and simulation; discussed in the context to specific applications such as signal transduction.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: CHEN 482 or approval of instructor.

title: Sustainable Design of Chemical Processes
description: Sustainability in chemical engineering; including sustainable approaches to design and development of processes, products, energy usage, renewable energy system and emission reduction; systems thinking, process performance and mathematical tools.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 425 .

title: Zymology
description: Zymology and the application of fundamental principles of chemical engineering in the production of fermented foods, specifically the beer brewing process; exploration of the basics of food fermentation and fermented beverage preparation technology as well as providing fundamental knowledge in beer production methods and processes.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Must be 21 years of age; junior or senior classification; chemical engineering major.

title: Chemical Engineering Car Design
description: Application of chemical, physical and engineering principles in design process, idea generation and development of design concepts, economic, safety and performance analysis. May be taken four times for credit.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: CHEN 204 , CHEN 205 ; junior or senior classification or approval of instructor.
repeatability: May be taken four times for credit.

title: Bioreactor Engineering
description: Fundamentals of microbial and enzyme kinetics; basic biochemical reaction theory and reactor systems; heterogeneous reactions and transport considerations in enzyme and cell reactors, and immobilized systems; bioreactor design considerations in bioprocessing.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Grade of C or better in CHEN 282, CHEN 482 , or BAEN 302 ; junior or senior classification or approval of instructor. Cross Listing: BAEN 471/CHEN 471 .

title: Electrochemical Science and Engineering
description: Examination of basic principles of electrochemistry, electroanalytical characterization, and electrochemical devices; exploration of electrochemical processes in the context of kinetics, thermodynamics, and transport.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: CHEN 205 ; junior or senior classification.

title: Microelectronics Process Engineering
description: State-of-the-art process engineering principles on microelectronics, especially for the fabrication of very large scale integrated circuits (VLSICs); fundamental unit processes, such as thin film deposition, thermal growth, lithography, etching and doping, material structures and properties, and basic device operation principles.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: CHEN 354 and CHEN 364 or approval of instructor; CHEM 322 .

title: Applied Catalysis
description: Principles of catalysis and applications to industrial reactions; catalyst preparation, methods for catalyst characterization, deactivation mechanisms and regeneration techniques, catalyst testing (laboratory and industrial reactors), fundamentals of kinetics of heterogeneous reactions; applications to selected industrial processes.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 354 ; Grade of C or better in CHEN 364 or concurrent enrollment; junior or senior classification; Qatar campus.

title: Advanced Process Economics and Finance for Chemical Engineers
description: Application of economic principles and valuation techniques from projects to entire companies; background in debt, equity, cost of capital, and determination of a company-specific discount rate; development of financial models which include risk and uncertainty; foundation for consideration in a career in management with significant financial responsibility.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 425 or approval of instructor and Department Head.

title: Process Synthesis, Integration and Intensification
description: Systematic methods for the synthesis, integration and intensification of chemical processes; special focus given to systematic process intensification for energy and the environment with applications to carbon capture and storage, energy systems, gas separation, and utility networks.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 425 or approval of instructor.

title: Fundamentals of Heterogeneous Catalysis
description: Basic concepts in kinetics and thermodynamics, reaction mechanisms, turnover frequencies and activity and selectivity; principles and applications of catalysis in industry including energy, chemicals and pollution abatement; connection of catalyst design to catalyst synthesis and characterization techniques that enable the creation, identification and enumeration of active sites.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEM 227 or CHEM 257 ; grade of C or better in CHEM 322 or CHEM 328 ; or approval of instructor.

title: Seminar
description: Preparation of oral and written reports on selected topics from recent technical publications, done in the context of consideration of the ethical ramifications of engineering decisions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Grade of C or better in CHEN 205 and ENGL 210 ; grade of C or better in CHEN 304 or current enrollment; junior classification in chemical engineering.

title: Bioprocess Engineering
description: Application of engineering principles to design of biocatalysts and bioprocesses.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Grade of C or better in CHEN 205 , CHEN 324 , and CHEN 364 .

title: Internship
description: Professional internship in a private company, government agency or laboratory, university, or organization to provide work and research experience related to chemical engineering. Must be taken on a satisfactory/unsatisfactory basis.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: CHEN 204 and ENGL 210 ; junior or senior classification or approval of instructor.

title: Directed Studies
description: Work covers one or more problems in chemical engineering processes or operations.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Approval of department head.

title: Special Topics in...
description: Selected topics in an identified area of chemical engineering. May be repeated for credit.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: Senior classification in chemical engineering or approval of instructor.

title: Research
description: Research conducted under the direction of faculty member in chemical engineering. May be repeated 2 times for credit.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Junior or Senior classification and approval of instructor.
repeatability: May be repeated 2 times for credit.
